candidates.review_note: A state is the subset of fairies on the far bank. Validate every state against both kinds of constraints. One teleport flips any nonempty subset of at most r fairies, including simultaneous transfers in both directions, so adjacency is XOR with a Hamming ball. Breadth-first layers give minimum teleport count; their exact path counts are XOR-convolved with that ball using an integer Walsh-Hadamard transform. Filter out invalid and previously reached states after each layer, preserving only shortest-path counts. The ball transform depends only on frequency popcount and is computed from signed binomial sums. No modulus or floating arithmetic loses the required exact number of schemes.
